meta.title: fix: refactor EBS snapshots module (issue #665, #1414)
meta.body_summary: Migrate EBS snapshots intel module to the new datamodel approach, addressing performance and stability issues from #665 and #1414, with integration tests and AGENTS.md update.

perf_labels.notes: Codex migrated EBS snapshots from old intel module to new datamodel; reviewers requested minor nits (comment removal, test naming); after fixes, PR merged with test evidence but no benchmark.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 16236 changed lines across 200 files, this is a large PR by absolute volume, but most changes come from a merge commit pulling in many unrelated new modules; the core snapshot refactor is only ~215 lines. This moderate-sized perf fix merged after addressing reviewer nits, consistent with outcome.

The change also touched models, tests, and AGENTS.md guidance.
